title: Fast Double-7 channel dip on 2-hour candles, flat within the day

source.title: Larry Connors Double 7 Strategy (StrategyQuant), via lab hypothesis H-020

rule_summary: Signals on CLOSED 2-hour candles built from completed 1h bars (UTC blocks 00,02,..,22), fill at the next 1h open. ENTRY when a 2h candle closes with close > SMA(200) of 2h closes AND close <= lowest 2h close of the last 7 candles (including itself) AND no open position. EXIT when a 2h candle closes with close >= highest 2h close of the last 7 candles (including itself). STOP: fixed 2% below entry (native). No cooldown. DAY-TRADE FRAME (same for every fast variant): entries only on bars opening 00:00-16:00 UTC, at most 2 entries per pair per UTC day; any open position is sold at the open of the 23:00 UTC bar or 12 hourly bars after entry, whichever comes first (never held overnight). Long only, spot, one position per pair, no pyramiding.
mechanism: Buy a 7-candle closing low inside an uptrend and sell the 7-candle closing high; the parent's lookbacks kept, candle shrunk from 1 day to 2 hours so the swing is about 14 hours. Fast variant of a tried rule: the parent holds days or weeks; this one is forced flat within the day so the dry-run reaches 60 trades in weeks. Costs (0.30% round trip) are NOT relaxed.
